problem: A cached older app could open before its replacement worker activated, leaving the Menu maps navigation absent. The installed Android APK is a separate bundled release.
changes: Existing web app launch awaits activated worker with exact release and complete cache handshake
Release page and app home link directly to Menu maps
Phone navigation uses four equal columns
Help uses the shared release version
Future in-app upgrades offer a deliberate Reload FINDR control
Android update guidance explains that the APK must be updated separately

verification.command: node --test --test-isolation=none --test-reporter=spec tests/app-update.test.mjs tests/menu-maps.test.mjs tests/practice.test.mjs tests/service-worker-redirects.test.mjs tests/offline-recovery.test.mjs
localBrowser: Release page Open Menu maps reaches app/#menus with 4,366 entries
320px iframe:release and menu page content width 305px, no horizontal overflow
All four navigation links share one row with client/scroll widths 66px
limits: Managed HTTP preview does not support service workers; update/activation cases use stateful regression tests plus the actual worker in a VM.
No physical Android or iPhone test.
User device and viewing method have not been supplied; the observed code defect is a possible cause, not a confirmed device diagnosis.

storage: No clear-site-data, IndexedDB deletion, worker unregistration or PDF/progress reset is used.
